title: Youthcare Infoflow Survey: analysis pipeline
description:
Analysis pipeline, figures and additional files for an exploratory cross-sectional survey on information flow in youth care at two Dutch organisations (N=You and Levvel; N=72), accompanying an article submitted to BMC Health Services Research.

Contents: the analysis pipeline (run_all.py) with tests that run on synthetic data; Figures 1-5 of the article; and Additional files 1-5 (questionnaire items, bridged-item matrix, descriptive results, Top-2 plots and the open-text pattern framework).

Participant-level survey data and open-text responses are not included, to protect participant privacy.

Licences: the code is MIT; the additional files, Figures 1-5 and the metadata tables are CC BY 4.0.
